title: Structured-output regression harness for JSON schema drift
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: We have seen intermittent production regressions where model/config changes (temp, quantization, prompt rewrites, or new model variants) cause structured outputs to diverge from the expected JSON schema (missing keys, wrong types, extra fields). These regressions can silently break downstream consumers (agents, ingestion pipelines, analytics).

Goal: Build an automated regression harness and monitoring pipeline that ties structured-output (JSON) schema adherence to config and model changes. The harness should run as part of pre-deploy/eval CI and continuously in production, surface per-model+config metrics in the Console, and trigger alerts / Linear tickets when regression thresholds are exceeded.

Scope & Acceptance Criteria:
1) Eval runner: Add a new schema-check eval step to the existing evals framework that compares model outputs against a canonical JSON schema and computes: schema_violation_rate, missing_key_rate, type_mismatch_rate, extra_field_rate, and example diffs.
2) Baselines & Snapshots: Capture a baseline snapshot per (model, quantization, prompt_config) combo. Baseline snapshots stored in S3 with versioned schema references.
3) CI & Deploy gating: Integrate the schema-check into model deployment CI so that "preflight" deploys fail if regression delta > configurable thresholds.
4) Console integration: Expose a per-route / per-model structured-output panel that visualizes violation_rate over time, rolling baselines, and top offending prompts.
5) Alerting: Wire alerts (Slack + PagerDuty + create a Linear ticket) when violation_rate rises > X% absolute or > Y sigma from baseline for 1 hour.
6) Triage UX: Provide an example-diff viewer and links to failing inputs, PRs, and run artifacts; allow owners to mark false positives.

Implementation notes & approach:
- Schema matching: Support JSON Schema (draft-07 compatible) and a lightweight Redwood schema format that allows optional fields and fuzzy-key synonyms.
- Diffing: Produce compact diffs showing path, expected type, actual type/value. Store diffs as plain text artifacts in S3 and index in the Console.
- Statistical detection: Start with simple threshold + rolling window z-score; plan to add Bayesian change point detection later.
- Eval runner placement: Run locally in CI (short run on sample set), and on the nightly/continuous eval cluster for long-tail coverage.
- Data retention: Keep 90 days of run artifacts and 365 days of aggregated metrics in Prometheus/ClickHouse.
- Backwards compatibility: Provide a migration tool to generate schema stubs from representative outputs for on-call to "approve schema".

Acceptance tests:
- CI fails for a synthetic model variant that intentionally removes a required key (test harness included).
- Console panel shows a clear spike when we run a canary with a schema-breaking change.
- Automatic Linear ticket is created with links to failing run and suggested owner.

Risks & Mitigations:
- False positives from optional/heuristic fields -> mitigate by allowing per-route schema relax rules and manual "approve schema" flow.
- Perf impact for long-run (many requests) -> run continuous evals on sampled traffic and leverage KV caching of outputs.
- Schema version drift -> tie schemas to model+config pinned versions in baseline metadata.
